sources.entry: Librarian by ngmeyer - A standalone MCP server that gives Claude a markdown second-brain over any Obsidian vault or folder of .md files, with trigram search, auto-wikilinks on write, and real graph analytics (Louvain communities, PageRank, shortest-path, D3 visualization). Runs entirely locally with no network calls or telemetry, productionizing the "LLM wiki" pattern.

summary.one_liner: Librarian is a standalone, local MCP server that gives Claude read, write, search and graph-analysis tools over an Obsidian vault or any folder of markdown files.
summary.what_it_does: Librarian runs as a binary that Claude connects to over stdio via the Model Context Protocol. It exposes 17 tools for reading, writing, listing and tagging markdown files, plus daily-note creation and importing PDF, DOCX and image files to markdown (the import tool requires MarkItDown). Search uses an in-memory trigram index built at startup. When writing with library_write, it wraps mentions of existing note titles in [[wikilinks]], respecting frontmatter aliases and skipping code, URLs and existing links. Graph tools build a bidirectional link graph for BFS traversal, shortest path, connected components, hubs, bridges and orphans. Community detection uses Louvain, and the report and visualize tools produce god-node rankings (betweenness and PageRank) and a D3.js HTML graph view. The --setup flag writes config into Claude Desktop and Claude Code and installs a /librarian skill with 12 slash commands.
use_cases: Search across an Obsidian vault from Claude
Automatically link related notes when Claude writes files
Map how notes connect and find hub or orphan notes
Detect topic clusters in a markdown knowledge base
Append to a daily journal note from Claude
Convert PDFs or DOCX files into vault markdown
how_to_run: Restart Claude, then use /librarian analyze, /librarian search or /librarian status
notable: Runs entirely locally with no network calls or telemetry, per the README
Auto-wikilinks only on explicit library_write calls, never on files the user did not ask to change
Louvain community detection plus PageRank and betweenness for god-node ranking
--setup writes Claude Desktop and Claude Code configs with backups and installs a /librarian skill
caveats: library_import depends on the separately installed MarkItDown tool
Multi-vault via LIBRARIAN_VAULTS is Unix only (colon-separated)
Source build requires Rust and the README's cargo install command is truncated
